name: show_penalized

upcoming_changes_stats.name: ai_bot_enable_docked_composer
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enable the docked chat-style composer for AI bot conversations instead of the standard floating composer.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: boards_enabled
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Organize topics, and lightweight standalone “floater” cards, into configurable, drag-and-drop kanban-style boards and columns, all with a purpose built management UI and per-board access control

upcoming_changes_stats.name: chat_pinned_messages
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enable pinned messages in chat channels.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: composer_media_optimization_image_convert_enabled
upcoming_changes_stats.humanized_name: Composer media optimization image convert enabled
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enables client-side conversion of JXL, HEIC, and animated GIF images before upload. JXL and HEIC are converted to JPEG, animated GIFs larger than the threshold are converted to animated WEBP.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: dashboard_improvements
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enables the redesigned admin dashboard that lets you pin custom reports and includes improved site traffic, engagement, and other analytics tied to community success and value.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_ai_bot_starred_conversations
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Allow users to star AI bot conversations and show them in a Starred sidebar section.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_category_hashtag_cards
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Shows a floating category card when a category hashtag is clicked if the user has permission to view that category.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_composer_redesign
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enable the redesigned composer.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_composer_toolbar_customization
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Let members choose which buttons appear in their composer toolbar, from their interface preferences.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_discourse_reactions_by_default
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Changes the default value for the Discourse reactions enabled setting from disabled to enabled when this upcoming change is enabled.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_discourse_workflows
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enable the discourse-workflows plugin.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_events_category_type_setup
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enables the Events category type option during category creation setup.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_generated_llms_txt
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Generates a concise /llms.txt when no custom file is uploaded. The document describes public discovery routes, the preferred Discourse MCP interface, and responsible agent access. To tune automated access, configure Slow down crawler user agents and Slow down crawler rate.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_horizon_high_context_topic_cards
upcoming_changes_stats.humanized_name: Enable Horizon high context topic cards
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Shows richer topic cards in the Horizon theme, including topic excerpts, tags, and plugin extended information.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_ideas_category_type_setup
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enables the Ideas category type option during category creation setup.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_improved_event_reminders
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Lets members choose whether event reminders are sent as personal messages, notifications, or not at all.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_invite_modal_with_roles
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enables a redesigned invite flow that lets admins invite someone directly as an admin. The invitee becomes a moderator on signup and an admin once the inviter confirms via email.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_local_logins_via_code
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Allow members to sign up, accept invitations, and log in with one-time email codes (OTPs), without requiring a password.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_markdown_endpoints
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Serve supported topics and topic lists as Markdown through .md URLs and requests with an Accept: text/markdown header. Normal visibility and profile privacy rules always apply.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_new_chat_reactions_popup
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enable the redesigned reactions popup on chat messages, showing who reacted with infinite scroll and a native mobile experience.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_new_checkbox_style
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enable the redesigned checkbox style for FormKit checkboxes.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_new_defaults_for_trust_level_3_requirements
upcoming_changes_stats.humanized_name: Enable new defaults for trust level 3 requirements
upcoming_changes_stats.description: We have updated the TL3 default requirements so they’re more reasonable for members of large, active communities. If you have previously overridden these settings, this upcoming change will have no effect.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_new_post_reactions_menu
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enable the redesigned post likes and reactions menu, with infinite scroll and a native mobile experience.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_new_post_reply_count_position
upcoming_changes_stats.humanized_name: Enable new post reply count position
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Move the post reactions summary before the reply count in the post controls.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_simplified_category_creation
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enables a simplified category creation flow with fewer options and a cleaner interface.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_solved_shared_issues
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Adds a “Me too” button to unsolved topics in support categories, letting members signal they’re experiencing the same issue and opt-in to notifications about the topic's solution.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_support_category_type_setup
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enables the Support category type option during category creation setup.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: enable_unified_new
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Replace the separate New and Unread lists with a single unified New list that makes it easier for members to distinguish between new topics and topics with new replies. When enabled, the /new route shows a combined view with subtabs for Topics (new topics) and Replies (tracked topics with new replies), and the unread option is removed from the top menu.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: floating_dismiss_topics_on_mobile
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Shows a floating 'Dismiss...' button on mobile for the topic list for easier access and to free up space in the top of the topic list

upcoming_changes_stats.name: granular_anonymous_and_logged_in_groups_permissions
upcoming_changes_stats.humanized_name: Granular anonymous and logged in groups permissions
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Makes group-based site setting permissions treat 'everyone' as 'all logged-in users', and enables the new 'anonymous_users' and 'logged_in_users' pseudogroups so admins can explicitly target anonymous visitors and authenticated users.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: improved_crawler_detection
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Enables improved crawler tracking which can better detect likely crawlers and ensure traffic reporting is more accurate.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: modernize_foundation_theme
upcoming_changes_stats.description: This change introduces design modifcations to the Foundation theme in Discourse.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: prioritize_recently_used_tags
upcoming_changes_stats.description: When adding tags while creating or editing a topic, show the tags the member has recently used on their own topics at the top of the list, before the most popular tags of the forum.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: remove_and_replace_uncategorized
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Replaces the special Uncategorized category with a standard category of the same name, and migrates all topics over to it.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: rename_faq_to_guidelines
upcoming_changes_stats.description: This change renames the FAQ page to Guidelines. The FAQ page will still be available at /faq. The FAQ URL setting works as before.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: reporting_improvements
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Improvements to navigation, design, and usability for Discourse's admin reports.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: sidebar_user_navigation
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Moves the navigation for user pages — profile, activity, notifications, messages, invites and preferences — out of the horizontal tab bars and into a dedicated sidebar panel, the way the admin area works. On mobile the panel is served from the hamburger menu.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: update_pending_users_reminder_default
upcoming_changes_stats.description: We are updating the default for the Pending users reminder delay minutes setting to 30 minutes so that staff are promptly notified when a new member is waiting for approval. If you have previously changed this setting, this change will have no effect.

upcoming_changes_stats.name: voice_enabled
upcoming_changes_stats.description: Voice brings integrated voice and video rooms to Discourse, with screen sharing, background blur, noise suppression, live subtitles, direct calls, room chat, and group-based permissions. Members can keep browsing while they talk, with no external app required.
